question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

Naïve
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Naïve"** means having a lack of experience, wisdom, or judgement. (भोला)

 
 
• **Example: **She was** naive** to believe that everyone she met had good intentions.
 
 
 
• **"Expert"** refers to someone who has a comprehensive and authoritative knowledge of or skill in a particular area. (विशेषज्ञ)
 
 
• **Example: **He is an** expert** in the field of artificial intelligence.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Naïve'** is **'Expert'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Confiding** (विश्वासपात्र): Willing to tell someone about a secret or private matter.

 
 
• **Example:** She was confiding her troubles to a stranger.
 
 
 
• **Besotted** (मोहित): Strongly infatuated.
 
 
• **Example: **He was besotted with his new girlfriend.
 
 
 
• **Rookie** (नवागंतुक): A new recruit, especially in the army or police.
 
 
• **Example:** The rookie cop was assigned to the night shift.
